$comment: Frozen baselines for the dotnet/maui -> Maui.Tizen extraction.
Every ref here is a pinned commit SHA or an exact version string, never a branch
name. origin/net11.0 advanced from ee4d06cde6 to bedd1b18b7 during the few hours
the initial import was prepared, which is exactly why branch names are unusable
Consumed by eng/import/filter-maui-tizen.sh and by the inventory/API baseline
tooling. Changing any value here invalidates the generated baselines and should

sourceBaseline.role: Forward source baseline. All net11-era Tizen sources are taken from here.

requiredAncestor.title: [Extensibility] Essentials: Bridge DI implementations to static facades
requiredAncestor.role: Minimum API floor. The import script hard-fails if this is not an ancestor of sourceBaseline.
requiredAncestor.note: This commit is NOT on dotnet/maui main. It lives on net11.0 and release/11.0.1xx-rc1.

behaviorBaseline.note: This is the ONLY ref that still carries src/Compatibility Tizen sources (70 files). They were deleted upstream on net11.0, so a net11.0-only baseline loses them silently.

developmentPackageBaseline.role: First coherent public-feed MAUI package set for net11. Used when building against published MAUI packages rather than source.

target.$comment: The workload contract this repository builds against.

workloadManifest.note: Not published to nuget.org as of 2026-08-26. Only the -9.0.100 and -10.0.100 bands exist; the newest Samsung.Tizen.Sdk is 10.0.128. This is an explicit external gate: the net11.0-tizen11.0 TFM cannot be restored or built anywhere until Samsung publishes this manifest. See docs/migration.md.

notes: No API16 or new reference pack is required; API15 is sufficient.
Tizen.UIExtensions requires republishing solely to drop its .NET 6-era Microsoft.Maui.Graphics dependencies. No API surface change is expected.
